name: Ice Linnorm
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Cold Iron)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Curse of Frost
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a creature slays the ice linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 40 Will Saving Throw save or gain weakness to cold 15 with an unlimited duration.

Effect: Curse of Frost

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d6+18) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Linnorm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 5d6 Cold Damage damage and Drained 1 (1 round);

Stage 2 7d6 Cold Damage damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Icemire Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The ice linnorm spews out a blast of freezing, viscous ooze in a 60ft Cone that deals 15d6 Cold Damage damage to creatures within the area (Basic DC 38 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The freezing ooze clings to those struck and hardens into thick sheets of ice. A creature that fails the saving throw is Immobilized by the ice until it succeeds at a check to Escape dc=34 or it or an ally Forces Open the ice (DC 34 for either case). At the start of its turn, a creature still immobilized by the ice takes 4d6 Cold Damage damage. Another creature can free a frozen target by dealing a total of 20 fire damage to the frozen target. Left unattended, the ice crumbles away in 1 minute on its own.

Creatures with the fire trait can't be frozen in place by Icemire Breath. Flying creatures fall if frozen, and swimming creatures that are frozen rise toward the surface of the water at a speed of 60 feet per round.

The linnorm can't use Icemire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Improved Grab as an action and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Improved Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv7spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv7spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

lv8spells.name: Unfettered Movement (Constant)
lv8spells.description: You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.
